title: Exact five-term homology ladder for external cup in the right coefficient
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X and Y quasi-compact k-schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals, F a quasi-coherent module on X [pqf-def-coherent], and S a short exact sequence of three quasi-coherent modules on Y in their abelian module category [def-sp-abelian]. Let c1, c2, c3 be specified normalized cochain realizations [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain] for F paired with the first, middle, and quotient objects of S. Fix n in N. Using the scalar resolution models [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model], there exist exact five-term rows A and B in k-modules, a morphism of rows phi, and isomorphisms eA and eB from their middle objects to source and target degree-n homology for c1. The middle arrow of phi is eA.hom followed by H^n(c1) followed by eB.inv. If H^m(c2) and H^m(c3) are invertible for every natural m, all four outside arrows of phi are invertible. No cohomological bound or induction hypothesis is assumed, and invertibility of H^n(c1) is not asserted.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, short exact sequence paragraph following equation 33.29.1.1 and the same argument in the right coefficient

proof.text: Construct the morphism of short exact integer Cech complexes with three normalized cochain maps and scalar model homology isomorphisms.

For any two normalized maps, tensor Kunneth identifies total homology with a direct sum of factor homology tensors. Lift factor classes through the surjective homology projections to cycles; normalization gives equality on pure tensors. Tensor-product and direct-sum extensionality, followed by surjectivity of the Kunneth equivalence, give equality on all homology classes.

Apply Mathlib HomologySequence.composableArrows5_exact and mapComposableArrows5 at integer degrees n-1 and n. Delete the first object with delta0 to obtain exact five-term rows. Their middle arrow is the first comparison, conjugated by a1 and b1. Replace the chosen normalized map by c1 using homology uniqueness. For the outside arrows in degree n, transfer invertibility through a2,b2 and a3,b3. In degree n-1 do likewise if n is positive; if n=0 both source and target homology objects are zero, so IsZero.isIso applies.

theorem picardExternalCupCochain_right_exact_ladder
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (S : ShortComplex Y.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (c1 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₁ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₁))
    (hc1 : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₁ c1)
    (c2 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₂ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₂))
    (hc2 : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₂ c2)
    (c3 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₃ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₃))
    (hc3 : IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₃ c3)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (A B : ComposableArrows (ModuleCat.{w} k) 4) (φ : A ⟶ B)
      (eA : A.obj' 2 ≅ (picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₁).homology (n : ℤ))
      (eB : B.obj' 2 ≅
        (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₁)).homology (n : ℤ)),
      A.Exact ∧ B.Exact ∧
      ComposableArrows.app' φ 2 =
        eA.hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c1 (n : ℤ) ≫ eB.inv ∧
      ((∀ m : ℕ, IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c2 (m : ℤ))) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, IsIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap c3 (m : ℤ))) →
        IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 0) ∧ IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 1) ∧
          IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 3) ∧ IsIso (ComposableArrows.app' φ 4))
